newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria's Bulgargas gives up stakes in firms.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria's Bulgargas gives up stakes in firms.

text.p: Bulgaria's gas monopolist Bulgargas will give up its stakes in seven firms and a bank and plans to set up joint ventures with foreign investors, its executive director said on Thursday.
Petar Sabev said the state-owned firm would also give up its participation in the Bulgarian-Russian investment bank, which had been approved by the cabinet on Thursday.
"We are negotiating with potential foreign partners for setting up joint ventures for the production of gas fittings, for example," Sabev told journalists, quoted by the state news agency BTA.
BTA did not elaborate whether Bulgargas' stakes would be sold or exchanged to cover the company's debts.
